The maintainer waived the model-tier mandate for `skills/**` while that tier had no quota; this PR was developed below it.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectstack-i18n 技能对象级翻译表的 `fields.{field_name}` 一行,在 `inlineTitle` 之后加上 `relatedListTitle`:lookup 或 master_detail 字段在父记录页上画出的相关列表标题;键在子对象的字段上,未翻译时保留作者原文,不会换成子对象的标签。另加一个 `'@objectstack/skills': patch` changeset。
- 为什么改:PR #29989 已让 `relatedListTitle` 可翻译(`translation.zod.ts` 的 `FieldTranslationSchema` 与 `i18n-resolver.ts` 的 `translateObject`),技能表还没列它。
- 风险与回滚:纯技能文本 + changeset。为新文字付账,删掉同文件 *Diff & Coverage Schemas* 下一段重复说明(`getCoverage()` / `suggestTranslations()` 无实现,*Service Contract* 一节已说);+219 / −222 字节;复审 S1 在 *Diff & Coverage Schemas* 开头句补回两个 schema 与 `getCoverage()` / `suggestTranslations()` 的对应(+111 字节),合计 5646 → 5673 tokens,上限 6333 未动,无 re-wrap。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 第 162 行;对照 `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` 的 `relatedListTitle` TSDoc。
- 需要你做的:Tier H 受管面(`skills/**`),需要 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 的批准;PR 保持 draft。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, the `fields.{field_name}` row of the object-level table: after `inlineTitle` it now lists `relatedListTitle` (the title of the related list a `lookup` or `master_detail` field draws on its parent's record page — the key is the child's too; untranslated it keeps its authored text, never the child's label). The wording mirrors the `inlineTitle` entry beside it.

Facts, read on `main` at `c23501b2` (the merged code of #29989):

- `FieldSchema.relatedListTitle`: `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` L1952; the field form shows it for `lookup` and `master_detail` (`field.form.ts` L320).
- Bundle slot: `FieldTranslationSchema.relatedListTitle` in `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` L248-263, addressed `objects.<child>.fields.<field>.relatedListTitle`.
- Untranslated fallback: `translateObject` in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` L4554-4561 overlays the title only when a bundle entry exists, so an authored title with no entry keeps its text; the child's label is never swapped in (docblock L4478-4487).

The optional example line was not added: it would cost about 110 bytes the deletion below does not cover.

### Token ratchet (no ceiling row moved, no re-wrap)

The added text (219 bytes) is paid by deleting a restatement in the same file: the paragraph under *Diff & Coverage Schemas* saying `getCoverage()` and `suggestTranslations()` have no shipped implementation and pointing at `os i18n check` (222 bytes with its blank line). Its homes stay in the file: *Integration with II18nService → Service Contract* says the same of the optional methods, and *Translation Coverage → `os i18n check`* opens "The working coverage path is the CLI". No test under `packages/**` or `scripts/**` pins the cut text.

The cut paragraph was also the one place that tied the two schemas to the methods returning them (`packages/spec/src/contracts/i18n-service.ts` L215, L228). Per the contract review's S1, the section's opening sentence (L340) now carries that tie in one clause: "The spec models coverage results for tooling — the return shapes of the optional `getCoverage()` / `suggestTranslations()` (see *Service Contract* below):". Only that line changed; no other line is re-wrapped.

|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` | 22604 / 22712 | 5646 / 5673 / 6333 (headroom 687 → 660) |

`.changeset/29990-i18n-related-list-title.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, with both declaration lines.
